changes.change: Modify default PLL clock configurations for speed grade 1, 2 and 3 devices to optimal configurations.
Add several RTL tie-offs to unused inputs.
Fix internal tieoff causing HPS peripheral operation to fail.
Remove internal tieoffs for hardened and unmapped ports which cannot be driven to GND or VCC.
Added error checking for inconsistencies between several PinMux related parameters.
Manually limit reset fanout for fpga2hps, f2sdram, hps2fpga, and lwhps2fpga bridge ready latency logic to improve timing closure
Added new parameters to FPGA-to-HPS Input Clocks to enable disabling of fabric-facing EMAC TX and PTP reference clock
Added legality checking for limited number of FPGA-to-HPS clocks for certain HPS interfaces. Displays parameter error message if limit is exceeded by HPS configuration.
Added option to choose either live timestamp or fixed timestamp
Added option to choose either manual ID or auto generated HASH as ID

changes.change: NOTE: The top-level RTL hierarchy of the IP has been modified
